title: Mother, son 34: shaking and jerking, now confused, has epilepsy

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 250 Ocean Avenue. It's my son, he's 34.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He was shaking and jerking all over for about a minute. Now he's stopped but he's confused and he's not talking.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he's breathing, he's lying on his side on the floor.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he has epilepsy. He's had seizures since he was a kid.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was he last acting normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ten minutes ago, right before the shaking started.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Don't put anything in his mouth.
